description: Rendering a route once at build time so its HTML and RSC payload can be cached and served directly from a CDN.
Rendering a route on the server at request time for each incoming visitor when output depends on live request context.
An exported async route function that returns an array of param objects telling Next.js which dynamic segments to prerender at build time.
A route segment flag controlling whether dynamic slugs omitted from generateStaticParams render on demand or immediately return 404.
Request-scoped Next.js APIs such as cookies(), headers(), searchParams, and connection() that switch rendering to request time.
